name: application-transaction-confirm-sheet
title: Transaction Confirm Sheet
description: Pending-transaction confirmation dialog with amount, from/to addresses, network fee, and total, driven by a typed amount/address/fee prop contract.
useWhen: Confirming a blockchain or crypto transaction before it's signed and broadcast.
Users need to double-check the from/to addresses, amount, and fee before an irreversible action.
A single focused confirmation step is preferable to a multi-page checkout flow.
avoidWhen: The transaction involves purchasable line items rather than a single asset transfer — use the Checkout Order Summary instead.
No fee or address confirmation is needed — a simpler Dialog suffices.
Multiple assets or a batch of transfers need confirming at once — extend this pattern with a line-item list rather than a single amount.
responsiveBehavior: The sheet is a fixed-width card meant to sit centered over a full-screen scrim; the address rows truncate long values with an ellipsis pattern supplied by your own address-formatting logic.
accessibility: The dialog uses role='dialog' with aria-modal='true' and is labelled by its heading id.
Addresses render in a monospace <code> element so character-level review (an important security practice) is easier for sighted users.
Cancel and Confirm are both full-width, clearly labeled buttons rather than icon-only actions, avoiding ambiguity about which is primary.

variants.title: Transaction Confirm Sheet
variants.description: Confirmation dialog with a large amount display, fiat equivalent, from/to address rows, network fee, a computed total, and cancel/confirm actions.
accessibility: Addresses are rendered in monospace so users can visually compare characters before confirming, an important anti-phishing practice.

variants.title: Transaction Confirm Sheet (Dark)
variants.description: Transaction confirmation sheet adapted for dark surfaces with the same amount, address, fee, and total structure.
accessibility: Amount, address, and total text must meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark card background.
